subject: BlueGear invoice intake: portal vs email and compact template questions
messages:
From: Ellie Strauss <ellie@bluegear.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding question — invoice submission channel

Hi Priya,

We're working through BlueGear's Redwood onboarding checklist and have a couple quick questions about invoice submission so we can wire our AP team correctly:

1) Preferred channel: do you require submissions via the vendor portal only, or do you accept invoices by email as a fallback (AP inbox)? If email is allowed, do you need a specific subject token or filename convention to route automatically?

2) Template: our current generator emits an XML payload and a CSV line-item export. Is Redwood able to consume a compact line-item CSV (minimal columns: PO, line_number, qty, unit_price, tax, sku, description) or do you prefer an XLSX with a header mapping sheet?

3) PO handling: does Redwood require the PO number to be stamped on the invoice PDF filename, embedded in the first invoice line, or is a purchase-order header in the XML sufficient?

Attached: vendor_invoice_sample.csv (CSV sample), and our standard onboarding form.

Thanks — want to get this right before our first bill run.

Ellie Strauss
Vendor Ops Lead | BlueGear Inc.
ellie@bluegear.io

[attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Strauss <ellie@bluegear.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding question — invoice submission channel

Hi Ellie — thanks for sending this over, good questions. Quick answers up front, then details and a recommended minimal template for the pilot: 

Summary (short):
- Preferred: vendor portal (fastest, idempotent handling).
- Email fallback: yes — we accept invoices to ap@redwood.ai but please follow the filename and subject conventions below to enable auto-ingest.
- Template: compact CSV is fine for line-item ingestion as long as required headers exist; we also accept XML (basic schema) or XLSX.
- PO: PO number must be in the filename (preferred) AND present on the invoice body or XML header to guarantee matching.

Details / implementation notes:
- Portal: when possible, upload a single PDF invoice and a separate CSV/XLSX/XML with line items. Portal enforces idempotency tokens so duplicate submissions are detected.
- Email fallback: send to ap@redwood.ai with subject: "Invoice: <PO#> | BlueGear". Filename convention we use for auto-match: "INV_<PO#>_<vendor-invoice-number>.pdf". If you cannot change filename, include PO in the email body with the exact label "PO:" on its own line.
- CSV template: required columns (case-insensitive): po, line_number, quantity, unit_price, tax_amount, sku, description. Optional: tax_rate, currency, unit_of_measure. We map based on header names so ordering is flexible. We prefer UTF-8 CSV, comma-delimited.
- XML: sample schema attached will work; please avoid nested compound lines — one invoice line per <Line> element with attributes as above.

I'm attaching a small compact_template_example.xlsx and an internal mapping guide. Jordan / Karthik — can you confirm AP's tolerance for our suggested subject/fallback conventions and whether we can provision a transient inbound rule that rejects emails without the subject token?

Next steps: Ellie, if you can return a filled onboarding form and one representative invoice (PDF + CSV/XML lines), we will run a single test ingest and confirm match.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Vendor Enablement Manager | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
[attachment: compact_template_example.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Ellie Strauss <ellie@bluegear.io>

Cc: BlueGear AP <ap@ap.bluegear.io>
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding question — invoice submission channel

Thanks Priya — that is super-helpful. A couple follow-ups from our AP team (cc'd):

- We currently produce an XML payload (see attached sample_invoice.xml). Can you confirm the exact XML element names you prefer for PO and line numbers? In our sample we use <POReference> and <LineNumber>.
- For the subject token: we can have our system set the email subject automatically. Is the literal prefix "Invoice:" required or can we use "AP Invoice:?"

Attached: sample_invoice.xml (our export).

On your second point about filename idempotency — we'll update our generator to write "INV_<PO#>_<INV#>.pdf". We'll return a test package by Wednesday.

Ellie
[attachment: sample_invoice.xml (xml)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ellie Strauss <ellie@bluegear.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 11:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding question — invoice submission channel

Hi all — quick tech confirmation from AP/ingest team:

1) XML elements: we can accept either <POReference> or <PO> as long as it's consistent. We'll map both names during onboarding. For lines, <LineNumber> is fine; the important fields are: PO ref, LineNumber, Quantity, UnitPrice, TaxAmount, SKU/ItemCode, Description.

2) Subject token: we can accept either "Invoice:" or "AP Invoice:". The ingest rule will look for the token prefix before the PO number. Example acceptable subjects: "Invoice: 4521 | BlueGear" or "AP Invoice: 4521 | BlueGear". We'll normalize on our end.

3) Email enforcement: Jordan — can we enable a transient inbound rule that marks messages lacking a token as manual review (not auto-processed) for the pilot? If yes, we'll proceed with the token approach to minimize false matches.

4) Pilot run: Ellie, please send a test bundle (PDF + CSV or XML) to ap+pilot@redwood.ai and cc ap@redwood.ai. That namespace triggers a dedicated ingest pipeline for onboarding tests and won't affect production flows. We'll reply with the ingest result and idempotency token.

I'll follow up with a short checklist (mapping + expected ack token format) once Jordan confirms the inbound rule.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
AP Integrations Engineer | Redwood Inference

- ingest_status: success/failure

- idempotency_token: <token value>

I'll monitor the first run and chase any mapping issues directly. Priya — I'll add the checklist to PROC-4872 and attach the final mapping doc.

Ellie — appreciate the quick turnaround on the test bundle.
